title: 3권 8유닛 장면 · 1
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. The characters must look exactly like the ones in the attached character sheet (left to right: Pip, Bun, Hedgie, Grumble, Beads, Pim & Pam). Scene: A sunny stream in the Pair Forest. On a wide tree stump sits a tall wobbly stack of colorful pancakes — a snack — and a little brown stick with a leaf lies beside it. Across the stream, on the far bank, stands a round door in a mossy bank with the two letters s and w carved on it — the ONLY text allowed in the picture. The water is too wide to jump. Bun counts the pancakes; Hedgie sniffs the air; Pip says the two letters in the wrong order; Pim and Pam sit on the stick. Up in the tree, Grumble's nose pokes out of the leaves, sniffing. Hidden in the picture: the snack, the stack of pancakes, the stick, Grumble sniffing. Characters: Pip is a small round yellow baby songbird standing on tiny orange feet, big sparkling black eyes with rosy cheeks, a cowlick of three little feathers on top of the head, a cream-colored belly patch shaped like a musical note, short stubby wings held like little arms, a small orange beak closed shyly, wearing a single small green leaf tied around its neck like a scarf. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Grumble is a grumpy old raccoon standing on two legs, dark eye mask, a striped nightcap, holding a tiny candle lantern in one paw, frowning sleepily, slippers. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads. Pim & Pam is two tiny twin bluebirds always side by side, one with a small red feather tuft and one with a small yellow feather tuft, round sky-blue bodies with white bellies, big shiny black eyes, tiny orange beaks, their inner wingtips touching, drawn together as one pair, no letters anywhere.
